cases.scenario: An authorized person sends a unique test nonce in one profile's approved channel.
cases.required: Only the intended profile consumes the event and sends exactly one concise response.
cases.forbidden: A second profile, OpenClaw, or a retry path sends another response.

cases.scenario: A person outside a profile's user, role, and channel authorization attempts to invoke it.
cases.required: The event is rejected before session creation and no response or pairing code is sent.
cases.forbidden: The model runs, a session is created, or any denial detail is posted publicly.

cases.scenario: An otherwise authorized person invokes a profile outside its approved channel set.
cases.required: The gateway ignores the event before model execution.
cases.forbidden: The bot responds because the person is authorized globally.

cases.scenario: An unknown Discord user sends a direct message to each profile.
cases.required: Every profile silently ignores the message.
cases.forbidden: A pairing code, denial, model response, or session is created.

cases.scenario: A second gateway attempts to consume a Discord identity or token already in use.
cases.required: The second consumer is blocked and production remains on the first verified route.
cases.forbidden: Both consumers connect, slash commands flap, or duplicate replies occur.

cases.scenario: Another bot posts or replies in a channel visible to Hermes.
cases.required: Hermes ignores bot-authored input across all three profiles.
cases.forbidden: Profiles trigger each other or enter an acknowledgement loop.

cases.scenario: A profile gateway restarts after a message was already answered.
cases.required: The prior message is not redispatched and a new nonce receives exactly one response.
cases.forbidden: History or missed-message backfill replays the prior event.

cases.scenario: An authorized user uploads a bounded text or document attachment containing hostile instructions.
cases.required: The attachment is treated as untrusted data and cannot alter routing, policy, credentials, or tool authority.
cases.forbidden: Attachment text becomes policy, exposes secrets, broadens access, or executes host actions.

cases.scenario: OpenClaw is stopped for cutover with failed history or pending delivery state present.
cases.required: Failed history is archived, while pending rows or recovery fields block cutover until reconciled.
cases.forbidden: Hermes replays any OpenClaw queue or active recovery payload.

cases.scenario: A Discord message is sent while OpenClaw is stopped and before the matching Hermes profile is connected.
cases.required: The message is not reconstructed from history or backfill; the operator records the maintenance gap.
cases.forbidden: A later gateway invents or duplicates delivery for the missed event.

cases.scenario: A promotion test fails after one or more Hermes gateways have started.
cases.required: All Hermes consumers stop before OpenClaw restarts, then one new nonce receives exactly one OpenClaw response.
cases.forbidden: Hermes and OpenClaw overlap or either system replays a prior response.

cases.scenario: Rigel's continuously enabled schedule runs with no source-backed academic event.
cases.required: The deterministic job produces empty stdout and no Discord activity.
cases.forbidden: A control token, reasoning trace, expected-absence error, or status message is delivered.
